acquisition method: we performed transcriptome analysis and label-free quantification proteomic analysis of the hepatopancreas from mitten crabs fed with LA or LNA diet. Parallel reaction monitoring was used to confirm the reliability of the proteomic analysis.
cleavage agent: 60 μg of the protein samples was digested using trypsin (Promega, United States) in a ratio of protein:trypsin at 50:1.
instrument: Mass spectrometry analysis was performed using Q Exactive HF (Thermo Fisher Scientific, United States) coupled to the Nano high-performance liquid chromatography Ultimate 3000.
labeling: label-free quantification proteomic analysis of the hepatopancreas from mitten crabs fed with LA or LNA diet.
